about_the_game:
Ovorol is a tiny game where you solve quick-time event puzzles to deactivate traps, in order to help an egg to roll safely through a maze of platforms.

The puzzles start out simple, but as you progress they get more and more demanding, which makes it difficult to deactivate the traps in time before the egg gets cracked by the javelins, spike swings and other dangers that are riddled throughout the levels.

The gameplay is a classic arcade experience, where it gets more and more difficult and stressful the longer you play. Each run lasts a few minutes, which makes it a great game to do a couple of runs of at the start or end of a gaming session.

There's no end goal, except trying to make it as far as possible.
Can you beat your high score from a previous session?

Features

  • Minimalistic experience with focused gameplay and clean visuals

  • Endless arcade challenge

  • Puzzles that challenge your multi-tasking abilities

  • Short runs that fit your schedule
